scope: Guided VS Code product-review and feedback-to-issue workflow tooling
behavior: PERSONAL and FIXTURE VS Code tasks launch a guided product review through Start-GuidedReview.ps1.
The launcher records an ignored ACTIVE_REVIEW.json marker and opens the app, private feedback workstation, and guide.
A twentieth feedback task captures one core-workflow finding at a time.
The walkthrough facilitator, feedback-to-issues triage, and later issue-fix prompts are separate phases.
Issue ordering prioritizes safety/data integrity, workflow blockers, high-leverage prerequisites, core workflow completeness, reliability, usability, then polish.

runtime_launch.note: This setup pass did not start the retained PERSONAL or FIXTURE MJobs runtime or alter private runtime data.
